description: Find peer-reviewed open access journals and their articles in DOAJ, the Directory of Open Access Journals. Search journals by subject, language, country, licence and fees, check whether one journal or a whole list is in DOAJ by ISSN, search articles by words, author, ORCID iD, journal and year, find an article by its DOI, and list a journal's articles. Start a workflow when DOAJ adds a journal or an article. No account or API key required.
